newsitem.title: USA: TCW/DW says to convert to an open-end fund.
newsitem.headline: TCW/DW says to convert to an open-end fund.

text.p: TCW/DW Emerging Markets Opportunities Trust said on Tuesday its shareholders have approved a shareholder proposal that the trustees convert the Trust into an open-end investment company.
Upon the conversion, the trust said the New York Stock Exchange will delist its stock.
The trust expects that the conversion will take effect by the end of its fiscal year in January 1998.
TCW/DW is a closed-end fund which invests at least 65 percent of its total assets in companies in emerging market countries.
